housing.summary: Numbeo reports an average monthly rent of EUR 818.67 for a one-bedroom apartment in Braga city centre; a deposit norm and main rental portal were not grounded from this source.

banking.summary: Millennium bcp lists valid identification, a taxpayer number, proof of address and proof of professional status among the documents used to open an account.
required_docs: valid identification such as a residence permit or passport

schools.summary: The Braga directory lists five international schools and identifies British, American, Portuguese, Hybrid, International and IB Candidate offerings; IB Candidate status is not treated as an authorised IB curriculum.

legal_admin.summary: EU, EEA, Andorran and Swiss nationals staying more than three months and up to five years must request a registration certificate from the city hall for their area of residence within 30 days after the first three months.
legal_admin.registration_step: Request the EU national Registration Certificate from Braga City Hall within 30 days after the first three months of residence, if eligible.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign citizen can request a Portuguese NIF online through e-balcao via a legal representative, or in person by prior appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop.

transport.summary: Transportes Urbanos de Braga (TUB) publishes a 2026 normal monthly pass tariff of EUR 12 for one fare zone and EUR 24 for two fare zones. Driving-licence exchange and healthcare registration were not grounded from this transport source.
